HeapTupleSatisfiesMVCC.brief_description: Primary MVCC visibility check: determines if a heap tuple is visible to a given MVCC snapshot by examining xmin/xmax against snapshot boundaries, hint bits, and command IDs

GetSnapshotData.brief_description: Constructs an MVCC snapshot by scanning the ProcArray to determine which transactions are in-progress, setting xmin/xmax boundaries and populating the xip[] array

StartTransaction.brief_description: Initializes a new PostgreSQL transaction: allocates memory contexts, sets transaction state to TRANS_INPROGRESS, assigns virtual transaction ID, and initializes all subsystem state

CommitTransaction.brief_description: Handles complete transaction commit: fires deferred triggers, records commit in WAL/CLOG via RecordTransactionCommit, clears ProcArray entry, releases locks and resources, and resets transaction state

AbortTransaction.brief_description: Handles complete transaction rollback: records abort in WAL/CLOG, clears ProcArray, releases all locks and resources, and performs comprehensive cleanup of all transaction-related state

heap_insert.brief_description: Inserts a tuple into a heap relation: assigns xmin to current transaction ID, finds buffer space, writes tuple, logs to WAL, and handles speculative insertion and visibility map updates

heap_delete.brief_description: Deletes a tuple by setting xmax to current transaction ID: performs visibility check via HeapTupleSatisfiesUpdate, handles concurrent update conflicts, writes WAL, and manages visibility map

heap_update.brief_description: Updates a tuple by creating a new version: marks old tuple's xmax, inserts new tuple with new xmin, handles HOT updates when possible, manages TOAST, and maintains tuple chain via t_ctid

TransactionIdIsInProgress.brief_description: Determines if a transaction is currently running by scanning ProcArray: checks cached subxids, handles subtransaction overflow via pg_subtrans, essential for non-MVCC visibility checks

lazy_vacuum_heap_rel.brief_description: Second pass of VACUUM: converts LP_DEAD items identified in the first pass to LP_UNUSED, allowing the space to be reclaimed for new tuple storage

HeapTupleHeaderData.brief_description: Core data structure for heap tuple headers: contains t_xmin (inserting xact), t_xmax (deleting xact), t_cid/t_xvac (command ID or vacuum xact), t_ctid (tuple chain pointer), t_infomask (visibility flags), and t_hoff (header size)

SnapshotData.brief_description: Core snapshot structure: contains snapshot_type, xmin/xmax boundaries, xip[] array of in-progress transaction IDs, subxip[] for subtransactions, curcid for command-level visibility, and reference counting for lifetime management

PGPROC.brief_description: Per-process shared memory structure: stores xid (current transaction), xmin (oldest relevant xid), subxid cache, lock info, and process state; mirrored in dense ProcGlobal arrays for efficient scanning

XidInMVCCSnapshot.brief_description: Determines if a transaction ID is considered in-progress per an MVCC snapshot: checks xmin/xmax boundaries and searches the xip[] array, with special handling for subtransactions and recovery snapshots

heap_prepare_freeze_tuple.brief_description: Analyzes a tuple's xmin/xmax/xvac fields against freeze cutoffs and prepares a freeze plan: determines which transaction IDs can be frozen (replaced with FrozenTransactionId) while maintaining MVCC consistency

HeapTupleSatisfiesUpdate.brief_description: Determines tuple visibility for UPDATE/DELETE operations: returns detailed status codes (HeapTupleMayBeUpdated, HeapTupleUpdated, HeapTupleBeingUpdated, etc.) enabling proper concurrency conflict handling

HeapTupleSatisfiesVacuum.brief_description: Wrapper around HeapTupleSatisfiesVacuumHorizon that determines if tuples can be safely removed by VACUUM, adding OldestXmin boundary checking to the core vacuum visibility logic

GetTransactionSnapshot.brief_description: Obtains the appropriate snapshot for a new query: in READ COMMITTED returns a fresh snapshot via GetSnapshotData, in REPEATABLE READ/SERIALIZABLE returns the transaction-level snapshot taken at first query

PushActiveSnapshot.brief_description: Pushes a snapshot onto the active snapshot stack, making it the current active snapshot used by table access methods for visibility checks; handles reference counting and copying

PopActiveSnapshot.brief_description: Removes the topmost snapshot from the active snapshot stack, decrements its reference count, and frees it if no longer referenced by any registered snapshot holder

RecordTransactionCommit.brief_description: Records a transaction's commit to persistent storage: writes commit WAL record, decides sync vs async commit, calls TransactionIdCommitTree to update CLOG, and returns the latest XID among transaction and subtransactions

SetHintBits.brief_description: Sets commit/abort hint bits on tuple headers to cache transaction status: checks WAL flush state to ensure crash safety before setting HEAP_XMIN_COMMITTED, HEAP_XMIN_INVALID, HEAP_XMAX_COMMITTED, or HEAP_XMAX_INVALID

TransactionIdDidCommit.brief_description: Determines if a transaction committed by querying CLOG: handles subtransactions by recursively checking parent transaction status via pg_subtrans, used extensively by all visibility functions

TransactionIdSetTreeStatus.brief_description: Records commit/abort state of a transaction and its subtransaction tree in CLOG: ensures atomicity when spanning multiple CLOG pages by setting parent last, uses group update optimization

ProcArrayEndTransaction.brief_description: Marks a transaction as no longer running in ProcArray: clears PGPROC.xid, advances latestCompletedXid and xactCompletionCount, uses group clearing optimization to reduce lock contention

GetNewTransactionId.brief_description: Allocates the next FullTransactionId: holds XidGenLock, checks wraparound safety limits, assigns XID to PGPROC, and records subtransaction parent relationship

heap_page_prune_and_freeze.brief_description: Core page maintenance: prunes dead tuples by following HOT chains, defragments the page, and optionally freezes tuple transaction IDs using heap_prepare_freeze_tuple to advance relation freeze horizons

vacuum_get_cutoffs.brief_description: Computes OldestXmin and freeze cutoff points for VACUUM: determines aggressive vs normal vacuum thresholds, sets relfrozenxid/relminmxid targets based on vacuum_freeze_min_age and table_freeze_age

HeapTupleSatisfiesSelf.brief_description: Visibility check for 'self' semantics: tuple is visible if inserted by any committed transaction or the current transaction, and not deleted by a committed transaction, including current command changes

CreateSharedProcArray.brief_description: Initializes the shared ProcArray during postmaster startup: allocates shared memory for ProcArrayStruct, sets up tracking for maxProcs backends including prepared transactions

HeapTupleSatisfiesVisibility.brief_description: Central visibility dispatcher: routes to the appropriate HeapTupleSatisfies* function based on snapshot type (MVCC, Self, Any, Toast, Dirty, Historic MVCC, NonVacuumable)

HeapTupleSatisfiesDirty.brief_description: Dirty-read visibility: like SatisfiesSelf but includes effects of in-progress transactions, returns xids of concurrent transactions in the snapshot for caller to handle conflicts

HeapTupleSatisfiesVacuumHorizon.brief_description: Core vacuum visibility workhorse: determines HTSV_Result status (live, dead, recently dead, inserting, deleting) and returns the specific dead_after TransactionId for recently-dead tuples

HeapTupleSatisfiesNonVacuumable.brief_description: Determines if a tuple is surely dead to everyone (vacuumable): wraps HeapTupleSatisfiesVacuumHorizon and checks the dead_after xid against GlobalVisState to make the final determination

HeapTupleSatisfiesHistoricMVCC.brief_description: Historic MVCC visibility for logical decoding: uses inverted snapshot semantics where xip[] contains committed (not in-progress) transactions, enabling catalog access in historical contexts

TransactionIdIsCurrentTransactionId.brief_description: Determines if a transaction ID belongs to the current transaction: checks main XID, subtransaction XIDs, and parallel worker contexts; used by all visibility functions to detect own-transaction tuples

GetCurrentTransactionId.brief_description: Returns the current transaction's XID, assigning one via GetNewTransactionId if not yet assigned (lazy XID assignment); triggers full transaction ID allocation on first modifying operation

RecordTransactionAbort.brief_description: Records transaction abort: writes abort WAL record, calls TransactionIdAbortTree to update CLOG status, cleans up invalidation messages and pending relation deletions

ProcArrayAdd.brief_description: Adds a PGPROC to the shared process array in sorted order: maintains dense arrays for xids, subxidStates, and statusFlags, requiring both ProcArrayLock and XidGenLock

ProcArrayRemove.brief_description: Removes a PGPROC from the shared process array: maintains sorted order by compacting the array, optionally advances latestCompletedXid for 2PC transaction cleanup

ProcArrayGroupClearXid.brief_description: Group XID clearing optimization: batches multiple backends' XID clear operations under a single ProcArrayLock acquisition, reducing lock contention at commit time

GetOldestNonRemovableTransactionId.brief_description: Computes the oldest XID for which deleted tuples must be preserved: scans all backend xmins and xids, considers replication slots, used by VACUUM to determine cleanup horizon

TransactionIdGetStatus.brief_description: Low-level CLOG lookup: reads the 2-bit transaction status (in-progress, committed, aborted, sub-committed) from the SLRU-managed pg_xact pages and returns the associated LSN

TransactionIdSetPageStatus.brief_description: Records transaction status on a single CLOG page: uses group update optimization where one backend processes a batch of status updates, reducing SLRU lock contention

TransactionIdDidAbort.brief_description: Determines if a transaction explicitly aborted by checking CLOG: does NOT consider crashed transactions as aborted, requiring callers to use process-of-elimination for crash detection

TransactionIdCommitTree.brief_description: Marks a transaction and all its subtransactions as committed in CLOG: delegates to TransactionIdSetTreeStatus for the actual page-level updates

TransactionIdAbortTree.brief_description: Marks a transaction and all its subtransactions as aborted in CLOG: delegates to TransactionIdSetTreeStatus, used during transaction abort and 2PC abort processing

TransactionIdGetCommitLSN.brief_description: Returns the WAL LSN associated with a transaction's commit record: used by SetHintBits to determine if it is safe to set commit hint bits based on WAL flush position

GetSnapshotDataReuse.brief_description: Optimization that checks if an existing snapshot's data is still valid by comparing xactCompletionCount: avoids expensive ProcArray scan when no transactions have completed since last snapshot

CopySnapshot.brief_description: Creates a deep copy of an MVCC snapshot: allocates memory for the snapshot struct and its xip[]/subxip[] arrays, marks the copy as owned rather than static

RegisterSnapshot.brief_description: Registers a snapshot with the current resource owner to prevent premature deallocation: increments reference count and adds to the RegisteredSnapshots heap

AtEOXact_Snapshot.brief_description: End-of-transaction snapshot cleanup: frees all active and registered snapshots, resets the snapshot stack, handles exported snapshot files, and updates global xmin state

GetCurrentCommandId.brief_description: Returns the current command ID within the transaction: used to distinguish visibility of changes made by different SQL commands within the same transaction

SubTransSetParent.brief_description: Records the parent transaction ID of a subtransaction in pg_subtrans: establishes the parent-child hierarchy used by SubTransGetTopmostTransaction for subtransaction resolution

SubTransGetTopmostTransaction.brief_description: Traverses the subtransaction hierarchy via pg_subtrans to find the topmost (root) transaction: essential for resolving subtransaction visibility in TransactionIdIsInProgress

SimpleLruInit.brief_description: Initializes an SLRU (Simple Least Recently Used) cache in shared memory: sets up buffer pool, per-buffer locks, and page directory; used by CLOG, pg_subtrans, pg_multixact, and commit_ts

vac_truncate_clog.brief_description: Truncates old CLOG, commit timestamp, and MultiXact segments: scans pg_database for system-wide oldest datfrozenxid/datminmxid, then calls TruncateCLOG and related truncation functions

FreezeMultiXactId.brief_description: Determines how to handle MultiXactId during freezing: checks each member's status, decides whether to keep, replace with a simpler representation, or invalidate the MultiXactId entirely

heap_execute_freeze_tuple.brief_description: Applies a prepared freeze plan to a tuple: sets xmin to FrozenTransactionId if frozen, clears or replaces xmax, and updates infomask bits to reflect the new frozen state

HeapTupleHeaderIsOnlyLocked.brief_description: Determines if a tuple is only locked (not updated/deleted): checks HEAP_XMAX_LOCK_ONLY flag and for MultiXacts verifies the updating transaction has not committed

HeapTupleHeaderAdvanceConflictHorizon.brief_description: Advances the snapshot conflict horizon by examining committed xids from tuple headers during HOT pruning or index deletion, preventing recovery conflicts in hot standby

heap_lock_tuple.brief_description: Acquires row-level locks on heap tuples: supports shared/exclusive and key-share/no-key-exclusive lock modes, manages MultiXact creation for concurrent lockers, handles wait/no-wait semantics

heap_hot_search_buffer.brief_description: Searches a HOT chain for the first visible tuple: follows t_ctid links from root to find the version satisfying the given snapshot, tracking whether all chain members are dead

HeapTupleGetUpdateXid.brief_description: Extracts the updating transaction ID from a tuple header: for MultiXact xmax values, resolves to the actual updating member's XID via MultiXactIdGetUpdateXid

GlobalVisTestIsRemovableXid.brief_description: Tests if a transaction ID is globally visible and thus safe to remove: converts 32-bit XID to full XID and checks against global visibility state, used by page-level pruning decisions

PreCommit_CheckForSerializationFailure.brief_description: Checks for dangerous serialization conflict structures at commit time: detects read-write dependency cycles that would violate serializable isolation, marking conflicting transactions for rollback

CheckForSerializableConflictIn.brief_description: Detects write-after-read conflicts for SSI: checks if a write operation conflicts with predicate locks held by other serializable transactions, creating rw-dependency edges

CheckForSerializableConflictOut.brief_description: Detects read-after-write conflicts for SSI: checks if reading a tuple written by a concurrent serializable transaction creates a dangerous dependency cycle

GetOldestActiveTransactionId.brief_description: Returns the oldest currently active transaction ID across all databases: scans ProcArray for the minimum xid, used for checkpoint and hot standby conflict resolution

heap_page_prune_opt.brief_description: Opportunistic page pruning triggered during regular heap scans: checks heuristics (page has dead items, enough time since last prune) before calling heap_page_prune_and_freeze

PROC_HDR.brief_description: Global shared memory structure containing the allProcs array and dense mirrored arrays (xids[], subxidStates[], statusFlags[]) indexed by pgxactoff for efficient ProcArray traversal

TransamVariablesData.brief_description: Shared memory structure tracking global transaction state: nextXid, oldestXid, latestCompletedXid, xactCompletionCount, and various wraparound safety limits protected by different LWLocks

HeapTupleFields.brief_description: Physical storage of transaction fields in heap tuple header: t_xmin (inserting transaction), t_xmax (deleting/locking transaction), and union of t_cid (command ID) / t_xvac (old vacuum xact)

SnapshotType.brief_description: Enum defining snapshot behaviors: SNAPSHOT_MVCC (standard isolation), SNAPSHOT_SELF (own-transaction visibility), SNAPSHOT_ANY, SNAPSHOT_TOAST, SNAPSHOT_DIRTY, SNAPSHOT_HISTORIC_MVCC, SNAPSHOT_NON_VACUUMABLE
